pkgmetadata.longdescription: Brave Origin is the Brave browser built with is_brave_origin_branded, which compiles out Rewards and Brave Ads, Wallet, VPN, Leo AI, News, Talk, Tor windows, Speedreader, Playlist, the Wayback Machine prompt, Email Aliases, the Web Discovery Project and the daily usage ping. Shields (ad and tracker blocking) is kept. P3A and crash reporting are still built in but off by default. It is free on Linux and installs alongside regular Brave, with its own profile in ~/.config/BraveSoftware/Brave-Origin.

use.flag: Allow turning on P3A (privacy-preserving product analytics) and crash reports, which are off by default. Without it, a managed policy in /etc/brave/policies forces both off; every Brave build on the system reads that directory, and shows itself as managed by your organization.
